I tested NeuroRester for 8 days alongside my Apple Watch to see what would happen when I added an active sleep and recovery routine to the data I was already tracking.

I started with a baseline, then used NeuroRester consistently and compared the results. No assumptions beforehand — just my routine, my wearable data, and what I personally noticed during the test.

Let the data speak.
